headline: Hiking the Granite Peaks of Northern Ireland
reservation: Access to the Mourne Mountains for day hiking generally does not require a central entry permit, though specific land access or local parking may involve fees. Visitors planning multi-day challenges should check with local authorities for group requirements or seasonal access changes. Always verify current status with official tourism or park bodies before travel.

days.title: Summit of Northern Ireland

stops.name: Slieve Donard
stops.detail: Ascend the highest peak in the range at 850m for spectacular views across the Ice Age granite landscape. Known locally as the 'daddy of them all,' it offers a challenging climb with views that extend across the region.

days.driving: Allow for local transit to trailheads; conditions and walking times vary significantly.
days.note: A high level of fitness is recommended for mountain ascents; pacing is a suggestion for a single peak day.

intel.title: Mountain Terrain
intel.text: The range is an Ice Age granite landscape requiring appropriate preparation for steep and rocky terrain. Higher levels of fitness are explicitly required for multi-day itineraries like the Six Peak Challenge.

intel.title: Multi-Day Challenges
intel.text: While single peaks are accessible, full range challenges typically span three days. Start early to account for changing mountain weather and visibility on the summits.

intel.title: Local Supplies
intel.text: Source evidence does not specify fuel or charging locations within the mountains; visitors should secure supplies in gateway towns like Newcastle. Verify local availability before entering the high peaks.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Network coverage is not detailed in official sources for these high-altitude granite peaks. Do not rely on mobile signals for navigation in remote mountain areas.

intel.title: Trailhead Access
intel.text: Specific parking capacities are not provided in official text. Check local signage at trailhead locations in Newcastle or the surrounding valleys for current restrictions.

plan.arrival: Arrive in the gateway town of Newcastle to secure supplies and local maps before heading toward the Slieve Donard trailheads. Check-in at local accommodation is recommended before attempting late-day ascents.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for reaching gateway towns, though local road narrowness should be considered; check rental agreements for off-pavement restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Slieve Donard summit offers panoramic views, though seasonal cloud cover often impacts visibility during sunrise and sunset.
